REA McGee are delighted to present No. 8 Carrigmore Manor to the  market.

This beautifully presented property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation comprising a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious open-plan living and dining area, kitchen, two spacious double bedrooms, and a family bathroom.

Ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Carrigmore Manor development in Citywest, this superb property enjoys a peaceful cul-de-sac setting with stunning views of the Dublin Mountains. Citywest offers an excellent range of amenities, including primary schools, shops, cafés, and local services, all within easy reach. The area benefits from outstanding transport links, with convenient access to the M50, N7, N81, Belgard Road, and the LUAS Red Line, while Dublin Bus services provide easy connectivity to Dublin City Centre and beyond.
